decision.recommended_plan: No tension between cost and retention here. The retention agent found zero critical or underwater employees in this population, so there is no one whose retention risk could be exposed by a phasing delay. The cost agent recommends day-one funding of the full 21,449.61 USD (driven entirely by NYX-001's cost_gap; NYX-002 and NYX-003 have zero gap), noting the total is small and concentrated enough that phasing would only add administrative overhead without any budget-smoothing benefit. Since retention has no critical-employee flags to protect, there's nothing for cost's timing choice to conflict with. Recommendation: proceed with day-one funding of 21,449.61 USD as the cost agent proposes.
